label: TheWaypoints
releaseNotes: 0.98 Beta 1: Settings uses one floating action: Check for updates when current, Download and install when the selected channel offers an update, and Install update for an already verified APK. Downloads are verified before Android installation confirmation; retry and cancellation remain available. Release history moves to RELEASE_NOTES.md. Existing Favorites, packs, application identity and signing key are preserved. Based on the original Waypoints idea and codebase by Vadim Sinitskiy.
